entity.name: Mile Marker 158 Dockside
entity.description: Mile Marker 158 is the newest member to the Wharf Restaurant Group family. Located dockside of the Springhill Suites Hotel, Mile Marker has the best patio dining view around — overlooking the Wharf's Marina. Dining inside offers a pleasant experience with an upscale appearance, while serving casual culinary cuisine and handcrafted cocktails. This hidden gem is the perfect place to visit, whether you're docking from a sunset or dolphin cruise, enjoying date night with your significant other, or even hosting a bridal shower, wedding reception, or business luncheon. Mile Marker 158 creates a relaxing dining experience and can accommodate large gatherings and caterings with a friendly and professional catering department.
entity.atmosphere: Upscale casual with waterfront/dockside patio views overlooking the Wharf's Marina. Pleasant indoor dining experience. Family-friendly with outdoor seating available.
